industry.why: Overweight, carried, and I am declining the row's own written condition for Double Overweight, said plainly: 'to A if relative strength reaches B with defensives still leading at three months' is met on its letter. Relative strength, 2026-11-13 against 2026-09-11, not week on week: B now, D prior (C at last week's reading), and the three-month defensives-against-cyclicals line is +6.3 points. Not taken because the condition was written to confirm a strengthening rotation and this week the rotation weakened on every window (one week -1.0 from +2.6, four weeks +3.0 from +5.6, six months +1.4 from +3.7, twelve months -0.6 from +1.9), breadth broadened for a third week with the index at its high, and the rate read that makes staples the destination is three weeks stale with the headlines running against it. Component 1 regime, 13-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its 52-week high, still present on Richard's European test and weakening at the margin for the first time: breadth up a third week to 66%, 60%, 62% and 63% of stocks above the 50, 100, 150 and 200-day averages, the three longer ones still below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, cyclicals ahead of defensives over one week and twelve months while defensives lead at four weeks, three months and six months; the causes unread by any reasoned source for a second week, web headlines only, and the headlines lean against the rates squeeze of the 30-Oct-26 read: the Federal Reserve easing, oil below $100). Relative strength reaching B describes a move already made; raising a defensive to the top letter in the week its lead narrows would buy the crowded end of it. Three live holdings (Carlsberg 4.62%, Fevertree 2.49%, Hilton Food 4.75%, 11.86 points) sit here. Counter-case: this is the goalpost-moving I refused on Consumer discretionary last week, and Richard may prefer the rule to the judgement. To A if the industry holds B at the next reading with defensives leading again at one week, four weeks and three months; to C if the three-month line falls under +2 points.

sector.why: Overweight, carried, with a China warning named. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): staples are the rotation's destination, but AB InBev's Asia-Pacific volumes fell 11% on Chinese beer demand (Outset Global, 29 October), and China is the weak sector within staples. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: B now, D prior, the market has started to pay. Two live holdings, Carlsberg (3.98%, with China exposure, Sell-side Momentum D) and Fevertree (2.00%), judged in component 4. Counter-case: the China leg is a company-level read on one brewer. Holds B with the staples industry; moves to A with it if defensives lead for a second month and the China read does not spread.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to Denmark this week (a source pack is present, 2026-W43, and it carried nothing country-specific here), relative strength is not graded by country, and Richard's view is G10 and Europe-wide with no country line. An absence is an absence; no tilt.

items.criterion: The 200D MA of relative price flat or falling over the month, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal at the Fri 13-Nov reading: Carlsberg's relative 200D MA rose 0.79% over the month, and 0.71% on 17-Nov.
At a flat relative price the rise falls to about +0.25% at Fri 27-Nov and (0.10%) at Fri 4-Dec, as February's high relative prices leave the window.
A sell signal at Fri 4-Dec sells the whole holding at Tue 8-Dec; about 1.4% of outperformance by then avoids it.

items.criterion: Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Beverages' Sector RS is 88 and Carlsberg's Stock RS 76, 38 and 6 points above the lines.
Sector RS +8 since Fri 6-Nov, to its highest in 13 months; Carlsberg's Stock RS (4).
About 2% of underperformance takes Stock RS below 70; Sector RS must fall 39 points by Mon 30-Nov.

items.criterion: The 200-day line rule: the 200-day MA of the share price and its stop-loss (the line less 6%), the whole holding sold under the 10-day stop-loss rule

bullets.text: Clear, day 0 of 10: the absolute 200D MA (DKK 891.69) is 11.4% below the close, its stop-loss (DKK 838.19) 16.7% below.
The absolute 200D MA is rising, +0.55% over 5 sessions and +2.06% over 20.
A close at or below DKK 891.69 starts the 10-day count; an exit confirmed sells the whole holding the next Tuesday.

items.criterion: Relative price more than 25% below its 52W high, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Carlsberg's relative price is 6.1% below its 52W high of 12-Feb (8.9% at the 30-Oct reading).
Relative price did not confirm the SP's 5-Nov high (4.6% below then).
At a flat market a sell signal at Mon 30-Nov needs the SP at about DKK 804, 20.1% below the close.

items.criterion: A tranche 30% below its highest close since purchase, with Stock RS below 70

bullets.text: No sell signal; no tranche triggered: the 30% level for all three tranches is DKK 722.05, 28.3% below the close.
Each tranche's highest close since purchase is the 5-Nov close of DKK 1,031.5; Stock RS is 76.

items.criterion: SS Sales or SS PT Net Upgrade Breadth below zero AND Stock RS below 50, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: revenue Net Upgrade Breadth +60%, PT Net Upgrade Breadth +40%, Carlsberg's Stock RS 76.
PT breadth is still improving (13 raising, 3 cutting); no analyst cuts revenue.
A sell signal at Mon 30-Nov needs Stock RS down 27 points and a breadth measure negative again.

items.criterion: Industry RS below 30, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal at the Fri 13-Nov reading (79); Consumer staples' Industry RS is 92 on 17-Nov, its highest in 13 months.
+13 in two sessions and +33 since Fri 16-Oct.
None at Fri 20-Nov: a 63-point fall in a week has no precedent in Carlsberg's readings.

adds.criterion: The rules: no sell signal from the six Sell Criteria

bullets.text: The rules allow an add: none of Carlsberg's six Sell Criteria gives a sell signal.
The nearest, the relative 200D MA, still rises 0.71% over the month.
A flat relative price gives a sell signal at Fri 4-Dec; about 1.4% of outperformance avoids it.

adds.criterion: The rules: room below the holding's limit

bullets.text: The rules allow an add: Carlsberg is 4.61% of capital now (4.02% at entry) against the 6.68% limit, 2.07% of room.
The room takes one 1.67% tranche, leaving 0.40%.
An SP rise of about 9%, with the rest of the book flat, leaves less than one tranche of room.

adds.criterion: The rules: no confirmed exit under the 200-day line rule

bullets.text: The rules allow an add: clear, day 0 of 10; an 11.4% fall reaches the line (DKK 891.69).
The absolute 200D MA is rising, +2.06% over 20 sessions.
A close at or below DKK 891.69 starts the count.

adds.criterion: Where Carlsberg stands for an add: pulling back or basing; may be Retesting or forming a VCP; healthily Retesting or breaking out

bullets.text: Pulling back, the first stage: 2.4% below the 5-Nov closing high in eight sessions, on light volume, 1.1% above the rising 20D MA.
The Master Dashboard says none of the three (pulling back 3 of 4 tests, failing on distribution days; Healthy Retest 0 of 4; VCP 0 of 4).
A light-volume touch of the rising 20D MA (second stage); a trigger day off it (third stage).

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: Add on Healthy Retest

bullets.text: Absent: the 17-Nov low stopped 1.1% above the rising 20D MA (DKK 995.58), on 0.98x volume.
A Retest now would be a second-or-later pullback since Stage 2 (advancing) began, the Reinforcing / Proven S2 route.
A low-volume Retest, then a trigger day (up 1.5%, 1.20x volume, top-quarter close) closing back above the MA.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: Add on VCP + Breakout

bullets.text: Absent: no base has formed since the 5-Nov high; VCP 0 of 4 tests.
Daily ranges have narrowed (1.65% over 5 sessions against 2.09% over 20), but eight sessions are a pause, not a base.
A base with higher lows, then a trigger day closing above the Prior Pivot High, DKK 1,040.0, 3.3% above the close.
On 13-Nov you wrote "Carlsberg - Metrics look fine"; on 12-Nov "Ergo, can add another Tranche of capital on Healthy Retest of a Rising MA".
On 10-Nov you wrote "Ensure we add a tranche if the stock Retests the 20D or 50D"; neither Retest has come, and your 18-Nov note is market-level only.
Your ruling on a 20D MA Retest add, whose Core tranche would need the 50-day or a wider line.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
